violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASHING THEIR HANDS AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS STOPPED THE EMPLOYEE AND INSTRUCTED THEM TO ONLY WASH THEIR HANDS AT A DESIGNATED HAND SINK.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) IN THE 2 DOOR REACH IN COOLER IN THE KITCHEN: RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RICE NOODLES. RAW SHELL EGGS STORED OVER CUT CABBAGE AND SPROUTS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM REARRANGED PRODUCTS INSIDE THE REACH IN COOLER. RAW PRODUCT NOW STORED UNDER READY TO EAT FOOD.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COOKED WHITE RICE IN THE TWO DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER IN THE KITCHEN AT 57F. TOFU IN THE GLASS DOOR COOLER IN THE HALL AT 44F. ROE AND IMITATION CRAB MEAT IN AN ICE BATH WERE 50F AND 57F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED COOKED WHITE RICE, TOFU, ROE, AND IMITATION CRAB. NOKU AT RESTON (Inspection Date: 10/06/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL BEING USED FOR COOKED RICE; HOWEVER, THE RICE WAS NOT MARKED WITH THE DISCARD TIME.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM MARKED THE COOKED RICE WITH A DISCARD TIME FOUR HOURS AFTER IT WAS REMOVED FROM TEMPERATURE CONTROL.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: FROZEN SQUID THAWING AT ROOM TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM MOVED FROZEN SQUID TO THAW UNDER COLD, RUNNING WATER.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: Walls around the sushi bar were observed with a rough texture.
violations.corrective_action: Wall, floor, and ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, warewashing areas, and toilet rooms. WALL AROUND SUSHI BAR MUST BE SMOOTH, DURABLE, NON-ABSORBENT, AND CLEANABLE. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.observation: Bowls were observed being stored inside the basin of the hand sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED THE BOWLS OUT OF THE HAND SINK. HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: Parasite destruction letters were not available during the inspection. Chef states Raw fish is delivered frozen.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. CONTACT THE RAW FISH SUPPLIERS FOR THE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTERS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: A date marking system was not observed being used in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. TRAIN STAFF TO WRITE THE DATE THAT THE FOOD WAS PREPARED ON. USE OR DISCARD WITHIN 7 DAYS OF DATE MARKING. SEE DATE MARKING DOCUMENT.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Food Establishmend Prohibited from ROP of Fish
violations.observation: Observed reduced oxygen packaging of Raw fish at the sushi bar
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment may not package fresh fish (raw, unfrozen) using a ROP method. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT A HACCP PLAN IS REQUIRED TO REDUCE OXYGEN PACKAGE FOOD. FISH IS NEVER TO BE REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGED. PIC OPENED THE PACKAGING AND REMOVED THE FISH. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO TAKE VACUUM PACKAGING MACHINE HOME.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PURCHASE A FOOD PROBE THERMOMETER

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) observed ice scoop being stored inside the ice machine with its handle touching the ice; 2) observed plastic to-go containers floating in the four soups in the prep top cooler
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO BUY LADLES FOR THE SOUPS. PIC PUT THE ICE SCOOP INSIDE THE WITH THE HANDLE STICKING UPWARDS.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of masago and eel sauce were observed reused for the storage of imitation crab sticks and ginger juice
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. DISCONTINUE REUSING MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS. PURCHASE MORE NSF APPROVED FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS
